items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we had a bass player named Herman Wright. All these people all came to my house, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, very poor. And I went to west side, they were better – they had nice homes and flowers and stuff, you know, the musicians over there. And there were plenty of musicians. Clarence Beasley, the pianist. He came to New York for a while, but he came back. We had a bass player named Ernie Phil, we had a bass player named Herman Wright. All these people all came to my house, you know.
So the west side came to the east side?
